comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
Always makes me happy to see more launchers on here. Neat little thing.

If I may suggest two design choices, I would create a Panel and put it in the bottom for the buttons to sit in. It’ll create some contrast from the wallpaper, and make them easier to differentiate.

You could also set the buttons up in a vertical list, then you can fit the Create Shortcut button underneath the other buttons.

Nice launcher!
